patch_description: This version uses a broader deterministic portfolio of staggered hexagonal and layered seed topologies, including five-row and six-row boundary-layer variants. Each seed is optimized with analytic geometric constraint derivatives, then only the strongest candidates receive an additional LP-radius-based polish. This concentrates computation on promising contact graphs while retaining enough asymmetry to escape overly symmetric local optima. Final radii are certified with a fixed-center linear program and a conservative numerical safety factor.
